outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic workflow diagram, not a data plot, so individual data points are not applicable.
Panel B shows representative fluorescence, H&E, and bright-field images, not a plot of averaged data.
The bar graph showing mean lactate concentration with 95% CI for normal, LUAD, and LUSC groups also displays individual data points (dots) for each region overlaid on the bars.
The bar graph showing mean lactate concentration with 95% CI for high pH and low pH regions also displays individual data points (dots) for each region overlaid on the bars.
Panel E is a schematic illustration summarizing the immunosuppressive niche model, not a data plot.
